instruction.en: Join the cat words to their meanings

pairs.right: the foot of a cat or dog
long hairs near a cat's mouth
the soft happy sound of a cat

steps.question: ‘It is raining cats and dogs.’ What does it mean?

questionMeaning.hi: ‘It is raining cats and dogs’ का क्या मतलब है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: ‘It is raining cats and dogs’ ka kya matlab hai?

options: Cats are falling from the sky.
steps.modelAnswer: ‘Raining cats and dogs’ means raining very heavily.

modelMeaning.hi: इसका मतलब है बहुत तेज़ बारिश हो रही है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Iska matlab hai bahut tez baarish ho rahi hai.

steps.sentence: The little ___ was playing with a ball of wool.

meaning.hi: बिल्ली का बच्चा ऊन के गोले से खेल रहा था।
meaning.hinglish: Billi ka bachcha oon ke gole se khel raha tha.

meaning.hi: हमें जानवरों के साथ प्यार से पेश आना चाहिए।
meaning.hinglish: Humein jaanwaron ke saath pyaar se pesh aana chahiye.

steps.question: Which big cat lives in the forests of Madhya Pradesh?

questionMeaning.hi: मध्य प्रदेश के जंगलों में कौन सी बड़ी बिल्ली रहती है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Madhya Pradesh ke jangalon mein kaun si badi billi rehti hai?

steps.modelAnswer: The tiger lives in the forests of Madhya Pradesh. MP is called the Tiger State of India.

modelMeaning.hi: बाघ मध्य प्रदेश के जंगलों में रहता है। मध्य प्रदेश को ‘टाइगर स्टेट’ कहते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Baagh Madhya Pradesh ke jangalon mein rehta hai. Madhya Pradesh ko ‘Tiger State’ kehte hain.
